'''Flaygin''' was a retired salvager who resided in [[Farpoint]] on [[Fhost]] at the time that [[Jaden Korr]] came to the planet. He was one of four players in the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game that ended in a [[Brawl in the Black Hole|brawl]].
